# The owner's routing rule as paths: the trees the reviewer routing text calls
# security-sensitive (docs/stateless-orchestrator/reconciliation.md F15, the rule
# documented for reviewers) plus the two trees this design adds to it — mobile/
# and the console, which hold credentials and MACs and must never be routine.
#
# One path per line. A "##" line starts a section and names the category; "#"
# lines are prose. TestRulesTableMatchesTheReviewerRoutingText holds every
# section name against the routing text, so a category cannot be invented here or
# drift out of the doc, and TestRoutingRuleFixtureIsNeverRoutine holds every path
# below to Sensitive — a routine allowlist that reaches one of them is a red
# test, not a quiet downgrade.
#
# The paths name real files of this repository where it has one: a category whose
# examples have all moved away is a category nothing tests any more. AGENTS.md is
# the exception, and it is here on purpose — the routing text names it as a
# category, so the classifier must place it whether or not this repository has
# written one yet.
